title: BayTurtle's Nonsense
description: A mod where I add whatever silly stuff I want, even if it's absurd.
body:
# BayTurtle's Nonsense

In this mod, I throw together a bunch of random stuff (often intentionally poorly made), even if they don't have a consistent theme.

Some may be cursed, while some may be oddly normal (until you look closer).

The top features include:

*   Mutant Turtles that love pizza
* Flintstone gummies (not what they sound like!)
*   Golden Potatoes & Mighty Potatoes (requires 8 DIAMOND BLOCKS)
*   Diamond Sword of Sharpmitepods (Has Bane of Arthopods, Sharpness, AND Smite all at the same time.)
* And so much more!

**If you see a bug, it's probably either intentional or I saw it and thought it was funny, but if you see one, report it anyway. I'll probably keep it regardless.**
